python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
cp .env.example .env  # then fill in OPENAI_API_KEY at minimum
python app.py --console      # Interactive terminal
python app.py --server       # FastAPI server (Teams + local web chat + AG-UI)

python app.py --copilotkit   # Alias for --server

uv venv && source .venv/bin/activate

uvicorn server:app --reload --port 8000
cd maf_copilotkit/web
pnpm install && pnpm dev

pnpm install && pnpm build
pnpm test    # run tests
pnpm lint    # lint code

Guidance for Claude Code. MAF learning repo with production PM Copilot and docs/examples.

Setup:
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
cp .env.example .env  # then fill in OPENAI_API_KEY at minimum
python app.py --console      # Interactive terminal
python app.py --server       # FastAPI server (Teams + local web chat + AG-UI)
python app.py --devui        # MAF Developer UI (visual debugging)
python app.py --copilotkit   # Alias for --server

Endpoints: `POST /api/local_chat`, `POST /api/messages`, `GET /chat`, `/copilotkit`. `GRAPH_MODE=mock` default; `GRAPH_MODE=live` requires Azure credentials.

cd maf_copilotkit/agent
uv venv && source .venv/bin/activate
uv pip install -e .
uvicorn server:app --reload --port 8000
cd maf_copilotkit/web
pnpm install && pnpm dev
cd tmp-ag-ui
pnpm install && pnpm build
pnpm test    # run tests
pnpm lint    # lint code
pnpm dev     # watch mode for SDKs

Star-topology: Triage routes to 5 specialists; specialists hand back. Triage: `maf/agents/triage.py`, no tools. Orchestration: `maf/orchestration/handoff_workflow.py` with `HandoffBuilder`. Tools: `maf/tools/`, `<REDACTED_USER>(approval_mode="never_require")` with `Annotated` params. Graph client: `maf/tools/graph_client.py`, lazy singleton. Config: `maf/config.py`, `pydantic-settings`, `.env`. AG-UI: `maf/agui_endpoint.py`, fresh workflow/request. Examples: `maf/agents/01_handoff/`–`05_magentic/`. New tools go in `maf/tools/`; new agents in `maf/agents/`; wire new PM Copilot agents in `maf/orchestration/handoff_workflow.py`.

Never commit `.env` files or secrets
Python 3.10+, PEP 8, `agent-framework==1.0.0rc4`
Update `ANTIGRAVITY.md` if architectural changes are made
See `ANTIGRAVITY.md` for MAF upgrade procedures
